lines: Trapped, no way out? Say what he said at the sea.
The sea in front of them. Pharaoh's army behind them.
And his people cried: We are surely overtaken!
Prophet Musa, alayhis salaam, said: No! Indeed, my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
Then Allah said: Strike the sea with your staff. And it split, each side like a towering mountain.
Facing a dead end today? Say it with certainty: my Lord is with me. Send this to someone who needs it.

beats.text: Trapped, no way out? Say what he said at the sea.
beats.ur: پھنس گئے، کوئی راستہ نہیں؟ وہ کہیں جو انہوں نے سمندر کے کنارے کہا

beats.text: The sea in front. Pharaoh's army behind.
beats.ur: آگے سمندر، پیچھے فرعون کا لشکر

beats.en: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken
[Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me
Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain

beats.text: Facing a dead end today? Say it with certainty: my Lord is with me. Send this to someone who needs it.
beats.ur: آج کوئی راستہ نظر نہیں آتا؟ یقین سے کہیں: میرا رب میرے ساتھ ہے۔ یہ اس تک پہنچائیں جسے ضرورت ہے

beats.text: Full movie of Prophet Musa (AS): link below.
beats.ur: حضرت موسیٰ علیہ السلام کی مکمل فلم دیکھیں، لنک نیچے

scenes.style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, no human figures, no silhouettes anywhere.

scenes.s1: A narrow empty shore at night between a vast dark stormy sea and high dunes, one beam of moonlight on the water, a feeling of being trapped.
scenes.s2: From an empty beach at dusk, a dark sea ahead; far behind on the dunes, a long line of tiny torch lights and dust clouds of an approaching army, no figures visible.
scenes.s3: A wide dark sea under heavy clouds, waves rising, one small break in the clouds letting a golden ray fall on the water.
scenes.s4: The sea parted into two towering walls of water like mountains, a dry seabed path between them glowing in dawn light, no one on the path.
scenes.s5: A calm sea at sunrise, gentle golden light on the water, an empty sandy shore and a single staff-shaped driftwood lying on the sand, peaceful.
